'''Xandral''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of [[Ukabi]]'s [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was defeated by an Imperial-allied individual.
